name: Gearbox bearing overheating
description: Progressive bearing temperature rise relative to load (lubrication / wear).

name: Generator bearing degradation
description: Slow drive-end bearing temperature drift with NDE following.

name: Hydraulic group overheating
description: Hydraulic oil temperature rise (pump / cooler degradation).

name: Transformer overheating
description: Phase temperature excess under load (cooling fault).

name: Converter cooling failure
description: IGBT temperature rise with load; may end in protection trip.

name: Stuck sensor (flat-line)
description: A temperature channel freezes at its last value. Expected outcome: 'unknown' via data quality, not a component fault.

name: Sensor drift
description: Slow additive bias on one channel; tests whether diagnosis abstains.

name: Data dropout
description: Missing rows from the SCADA feed.

name: Pitch misalignment
description: Blade pitch offset reduces output below the expected power band.

name: Yaw misalignment
description: Static nacelle yaw offset; cos^3 power loss.

name: Blade icing
description: Aerodynamic degradation at low ambient temperature.
